previousVideoRootCause.summary: Previous editor QA mp4 used a deterministic layout composite fallback when camera-rendered frames were blank, so the evidence looked like procedural pixel blocks instead of actual 2D illustration resources.

replacementNotes.reason: Launch-required 8 large visual surfaces are split across Backgrounds (6) and KeyVisuals (2).
Small plates, badges, meters, and empty-state UI decorations are acceptable as UI resources because high-quality reward/offline backgrounds already exist for the large player-facing visual surface.
Small signal, status, and feedback indicators are acceptable UI decorations, not primary illustration surfaces.
